title: ligusticum seguieri subsp. dinaricum
intro: Ligusticum seguieri subsp. dinaricum, commonly known as Dinaric Lovage, is a subspecies of the Ligusticum seguieri plant, belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Europe. Dinaric Lovage has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties.
